title: Secondo Assalto di Spada da Due Mani
poster_subtitle: di spada da due mani · gioco largo e stretto
citation: Achille Marozzo, Opera Nova · Bologna, 1536 · Libro III, cap. 163
subtitle: Achille Marozzo, Opera Nova (Bologna, 1536), Book III, chapter 163 · parts V–X interpolated from the text
refrain: There is no single refrain in the second assalto: most parts close by retreating into guardia d'intrare in largo passo or a porta di ferro.

parts.title: Prima parte
parts.note: Three cuts at the half sword: the hand slides up past the lugs for very fast cuts; the alternative is short half cuts.
steps: Falso dritto and falso manco together
He attacks head or leg: parry true edge
three cuts at the half sword: feint roverso, mandritto ridoppio, roverso
left foot to his right side, right to his left, right follows behind

parts.title: Seconda parte
parts.note: Two readings of section two: the sword's first circle goes to the left, or to the right.
steps: rising thrust to his right temple, hands crossed over his sword
right foot forward, off the line to the left, right foot again
He sets it aside: mandritto tondo to his left temple
right foot to the right, left crosses behind
He answers: parry with a tramazzone
left foot behind in a traverse, right follows crossed
right foot back a wide step
right foot follows behind the left

parts.title: Terza parte
parts.note: Two endings after the grab: the pommel to the face, or a cut to the head.
steps: left foot a wide traverse to his right side
Ponta incrociata, your false edge on his true edge
gran passo forward with the right foot
He raises to parry: duck under his sword, edge under his right arm (mandritto ridoppio)
gran passo to his right side
Presa: left hand on his right arm
pommel to the face, or a cut to the head

parts.title: Quarta parte
parts.note: Botta doppia: Marozzo allows the mandritto to the leg or the head; this reading cuts to the leg and keeps the original footwork.
steps: Botta doppia: falso strongly to his sword
left foot back, then right foot strongly forward
left foot strongly to his right side
He attacks the head: parry with the falso
left foot strongly behind the right

parts.title: Quinta parte
steps: left foot a wide step to his right side
He answers: fugge e cruove, back to coda longa e distesa
Gioco stretto: rising falso dritto to the hand
Feint another falso, ponta in falso impuntata over his sword
slicing cut to the face, or a roverso to his right leg
gran passo forward with the right foot
Roverso impuntato, stopping short of croce
left foot strongly to his right side
left foot a gran passo behind the right

parts.title: Sesta parte
steps: Float the play until he is in porta di ferro alta; take the same guard
Ponta incrociata outside his right side, true edge on his false
left foot strongly to his right side, right follows
He uncovers his left: presa, left arm round his sword, turn the hand onto his hilt
If he avoids it: two mandritti tondi, face then leg
right foot to his left side, left behind a little crossed, right forward
right foot behind in a wide step
right foot forward, then back to the wide step

parts.title: Settima parte
steps: Mandritto tondo to the leg, rising thrust over his sword
left foot gran passo to his right, right foot forward
left foot to the right, a little crossed
Left hand at the half sword: force his sword down, roverso to face or neck
left foot forward to force his sword down, then strongly behind the right as you slice
Left hand back on your own grip, back to faccia; if he does not wait, mandritto tondo to the leg
He attacks: defend with a thrust, kick to the stomach, roverso di mezza spada
left foot steps, right foot kicks, then right foot back
left foot then right foot back

parts.title: Ottava parte
steps: Falso, tramazzone through becca possa, ridoppio, mandritto tondo, all together
He answers: retreat twice, roverso trivellato
Falsigiare, back to testa; he attacks: mezzo tempo, roverso
right foot lifted over the left, then back in place
He attacks: ponta sopra mano to the face
Roverso trivellato, entering with a ponta impuntata
He attacks: parry with the hilt, mandritto to the leg or slice to the face
if he thrusts: under his sword, ponta in falso to the face
right foot traverses right, retreat twice

parts.title: Nona parte
steps: Raise the sword, left hand strong above
Feint roverso, mandritto tondo to the leg
left foot to his right, right foot to his left
Rising falso manco to the hands
right foot back a wide step
left foot traverses wide to his right
Feint tramazzone, mandritto tondo to the leg
right foot forward, then back to the wide step
He attacks: beat with the false edge, falso dritto
right foot to his left side
right foot to his left, left crosses behind
Feint to the head, mandritto to the leg
left foot traverses to his right
Feint mezzo mandritto to the face; he raises: roverso trivellato, ponta impuntata
right foot to his left, left traverses, right strongly forward
only the left foot moves, back behind the right

parts.title: Decima e ultima parte
parts.intro: From guardia d'intrare in largo passo against his porta di ferro alta, seven ways in:

options.label: a
steps: He rises false to false: cross, point to the right of his face
left foot to his left side
right foot strongly to his left side

options.label: b
steps: Thrust from below to the right of his face
His falso meets yours: mandritto tondo intrante
Presa, or roverso di mezza spada; if he retreats, mandritto to the leg

options.label: c
steps: Feint falso manco impontato, feint thrust to his left
He covers: ridoppio mandritto to the arms, knock his sword with the lugs
Roverso de squilo, almost turning your back
right foot strongly behind the left

options.label: d
steps: Becca possa to the right of his face; he rises: ridoppio roverso, presa if you see fit
right foot to the left, step with the left

options.label: e
steps: Falso manco striking his sword hard, roverso trivellato
